backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: The database, the secret key and the settings in one zip. Media files are never part of a backup.
backups.secretWarning: A backup contains the secret key and every setting, including the encrypted passwords and API keys of your services. Keep it as private as the server itself.
backups.scheduleHint: Scheduled backups and how many to keep:
backups.uploadHint: A backup zip made by Locarr (this or another installation).
backups.confirmText: Everything Locarr knows is replaced with the backup: library, settings, users and history. Locarr first backs up the current state, then restarts. Everyone except you is signed out. Media files are not touched.
backups.restartingHint: The page reloads by itself when Locarr is back.

monitoring.subtitle: Health checks, backups, cleanup and metrics for dashboards.
monitoring.updateCheckHint: Asks GitHub once a day whether a newer Locarr is out. Nothing about your setup is sent.
monitoring.housekeepingHint: Old history is removed after these many days; the database is compacted on schedule.
monitoring.metricsHint: Prometheus metrics at /metrics need this token as a bearer token. Without a token /metrics is off.
monitoring.statsHint: Dashboards can read /api/stats with an administrator's read-only API key (Account → API keys).

stop_sonarr.title: Stop automatic searches in {{names}}
stop_sonarr.body: In Sonarr turn off RSS sync (Settings → Indexers → RSS Sync Interval 0) and automatic search on its indexers, or stop the container. Locarr does not change Sonarr.

stop_radarr.title: Stop automatic searches in {{names}}
stop_radarr.body: In Radarr turn off RSS sync and automatic search on its indexers, or stop the container. Locarr does not change Radarr.

stop_lidarr.title: Stop automatic searches in {{names}}
stop_lidarr.body: In Lidarr turn off RSS sync and automatic search on its indexers, or stop the container. Locarr does not change Lidarr.

prowlarr_apps.title: Remove the old applications from {{names}}
prowlarr_apps.body: Under Settings → Apps in Prowlarr, remove Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr once you stop them, so Prowlarr stops syncing indexers to them.

prowlarr_not_needed.title: Stop using {{names}}
prowlarr_not_needed.body: No indexer searches through Prowlarr any more ({{indexers}} still do while this is open). Once usenet API keys are entered, Prowlarr can be switched off and deleted.

stop_requests.title: Point people to Locarr instead of {{names}}
stop_requests.body: Share Locarr's address (or an invite), and stop the old request application so new requests arrive here.

stop_bazarr.title: Stop {{names}}
stop_bazarr.body: Locarr searches subtitles itself now; two applications would download the same subtitles twice.

download_clients.title: Download clients and categories
download_clients.body: {{clients}} clients are on. Categories Locarr uses: {{categories}}. Make sure each client has them and that finished downloads land where Locarr can see them.

rss.title: Turn on RSS sync
rss.body: {{indexers}} indexers have RSS on; sync runs every {{minutes}} minutes. With 0 indexers or 0 minutes Locarr only searches when asked.

test_search.title: Run a test search
test_search.body: Search for one title by hand to check indexers and the decision rules before letting Locarr work alone.

secrets.title: Enter the keys the applications did not reveal
secrets.body: {{count}} imported items wait for a key or password: the applications hide them in their API. Until then those indexers and clients stay off.

adultSettings.title: Adult content
adultSettings.description: An optional library for legal adult content between consenting adults. Off unless you turn it on.

enable.title: Adult library
enable.hint: While it is off, nothing adult appears anywhere and every adult address answers "not found".
enable.warning: Only enable this if every person who will get access is an adult. Content involving minors is never allowed; entries flagged by the source and blocked terms are refused.
enable.confirm: I confirm that every user I give access to adult content is an adult.
enable.permission: Turning it on gives nobody access: grant "See adult content" per user in Settings → Users (administrators too).

keys.title: Metadata sources
keys.hint: Your own API keys for StashDB and ThePornDB. Keys are checked with the source and stored encrypted.

defaults.statsHint: Adds one number (adultItems) for dashboards. Nothing is ever broken down.
defaults.streameroHint: Only if you mapped a separate adult library in Streamero.
defaults.galleryFolderHint: One folder per gallery, directly in the adult root folder.
defaults.galleryRenameHint: 0001.jpg, 0002.jpg … in the set's order; off keeps the original names.
defaults.galleryCoverHint: cover.jpg (or .png …): the set's own cover, else its first image.

roots.title: Adult root folders
roots.hint: Kept apart from movie, series and music folders.
roots.needPermission: To add folders, first give yourself “See adult content” in Settings → Users, then reload this page. Even admins don't get it automatically.

indexers.title: Indexers with adult categories
indexers.hint: Off for every indexer by default. Only the ticked indexers are asked, in their adult (6000, XXX) categories. Adult-only sites (Sukebei, XXXClub) are ticked when added.
indexers.noAdultHint: These indexers have no adult categories, so adult searches leave them out even if they are ticked.

blocklist.title: Tag blocklist
blocklist.hint: Releases, imports and metadata entries containing one of your terms are refused (blocked_tag). Whole words only, in any case and with any separator. Everything else is allowed.
blocklist.protectedHint: These terms cannot be removed. A performer's own stage name that contains one does not count.

profile.title: Quality profile for adult items
profile.hint: Scene names on public sites often have no resolution or source, so they count as Unknown, which other profiles refuse. {{profile}} allows every quality, Unknown included, and is the default for new items.
profile.usage: On another profile: {{items}} items, {{studios}} followed studios, {{performers}} followed performers.
profile.applyNote: Only the quality profile changes; files, monitoring and history stay.
profile.missing: The profile that allows every quality was deleted. Pick a profile that allows Unknown under Defaults.

exclusions.title: Not interested
exclusions.hint: Scenes and movies you removed with “Not interested”. Refreshes of followed studios and performers skip them. Undo an entry and the next refresh may add it again.
